events.name: Moonlit Promise
events.reminder:
Moonlit Promise is active all week!

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Complete every daily task — points compound over 7 days
• Prioritize limited-time objectives first each day
• Don't skip any day; consistent dailies outperform burst play

📦 **Prep:**
• Save gems for event shop refreshes
• Keep speedups ready for any construction/research tasks
• Check event milestones and plan which rewards to target

events.name: Hero Rally
events.reminder:
Hero Rally is active! Recruit and upgrade heroes for points.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Use Hero Shards on heroes close to a star-level breakpoint for max efficiency
• Prioritize Mythic shards (125 pts each) over Rare (15 pts)
• Level up hero skills if you have spare skill books

📦 **Prep:**
• Hoard Hero Shards from chests — don't spend them before this event
• Stock up on Hero XP items and Skill Books
• Save Mithril for hero-related upgrades

events.name: Alliance Brawl
events.reminder:
Alliance Brawl is active! Coordinate with your alliance and push hard.

📋 **Daily Stages & Horn Values:**
Day 1: Rise of the City (1 horn)
Day 2: Hero Development (2 horns)
Day 3: Pet Training (2 horns)
Day 4: Gear Enhancement (2 horns)
Day 5: Trade Baron (2 horns)
Day 6: Full-Scale Competition (4 horns!) ← DECISIVE DAY

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Save Intel Missions for Days 2 & 4 — they score 3,000 pts each
• Day 3 (Pets): Use Taming Marks, especially Advanced ones
• Day 5 (Hunting): Burn all saved stamina on high-level beasts + terror rallies
• Day 6 is worth 4 horns — save your best resources for the final push
• Escort & raid trucks daily — huge point earners even on non-raid days

📦 **Prep:**
• Don't switch alliances after Saturday (matchmaking locks Sunday 23:00 UTC)
• Stockpile Intel Missions, stamina, Taming Marks, and speedups
• Must be in a Top 20 alliance to be eligible

events.name: Swordland Showdown
events.reminder:
Swordland Showdown is active!

🏰 **Rush Priority:** Royal Stables → Swordshrine → Sanctums
🛡️ Losses do NOT affect your city troops — fight freely!

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Grab Royal Stables first — faster teleports control the entire map
• Take at least one Sanctum early for steady passive point flow
• Capture the Hall of Reformation for 15% damage boost
• Bell Tower cuts capture time by 50% — critical for flipping contested buildings
• In the final phase, loot Under-cellars for sudden point boosts
• Never go solo — call out enemy movements, rally times, and defenses

📦 **Prep:**
• Coordinate legion registration with R4/R5 leadership
• Assign roles: rushers, defenders, and flankers
• Move cities close to alliance territory for faster reinforcement

events.name: Cesares Fury
events.reminder:
Cesares Fury is active! Hunt Cesares Rebels for big rewards.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Choose the HIGHEST difficulty you can manage — even incomplete runs give better rewards per stage
• Always use **Diana** in marches — her Iron Constitution skill (-20% stamina cost) is essential
• Spread attacks over 3 days to use naturally regenerating stamina
• Use Cesares Accords to get full credit without soloing — same rewards whether you fight or not
• For Cesares Captains: send 1 troop first so all alliance members can hit it, then go all-in

📦 **Prep:**
• Save 1,100–1,500 stamina before the event starts
• Level up Diana's Iron Constitution skill if possible
• Stock Governor Stamina Packs
• Help 7 allies with Accords to get Cesares Aid Chests (5% chance of Mythic General Shard)

events.name: Grow Your Heroes
events.reminder:
Grow Your Heroes is active! Use Hero Shards to level up star levels for points.

📊 **Point Values:**
• Rare Shard = 15 pts
• Epic Shard = 50 pts
• Mythic Shard = 125 pts

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Mythic shards give the best point-per-shard ratio — prioritize them
• Ascend heroes who are close to the next star level for milestone bonuses
• Don't waste Universal Shards here unless you need them for milestones

📦 **Prep:**
• Hoard ALL hero shards from chests for days/weeks before this event
• Save skill books and Hero XP items
• Check which heroes are 1-2 shards away from a star-up

events.name: Hero Rally (Round 2)
events.reminder:
Hero Rally Round 2 is active! Another chance to recruit and upgrade heroes.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Same as Round 1 — use shards on heroes near star-level breakpoints
• If you already spent most shards in Round 1, focus on Skill Book upgrades for points
• Check the event shop for discounted hero items

📦 **Prep:**
• Save any remaining shards from Round 1
• Complete daily quests that reward Hero XP and shards

events.name: Kingdom of Power (KvK)
events.reminder:
Kingdom of Power (KvK) begins! 4-phase cross-kingdom event.

📋 **KvK Phases:**
• Phase 1: Matchmaking (48h) — kingdoms are assigned opponents
• Phase 2: Preparation (5 days) — build, research, train troops
• Phase 3: Battle Window (12h, 10:00-22:00 UTC) — intense PvP combat!
• Phase 4: Field Triage — healing and cleanup phase

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Points from: Building, Research, Troop Training, PvP Kills, Territory Control
• **Attack Formation:** 50% Infantry / 20% Cavalry / 30% Archers
• **Defense Formation:** 60% Infantry / 20% Cavalry / 20% Archers
• **Best Heroes - Attack:** Amadeus + Hilde + Marlin
• **Best Heroes - Defense:** Zoe + Hilde + Saul
• Time TC and troop training upgrades with kingdom-wide buffs for 2x points
• Reserve your strongest marches for Phase 3 Battle Window

📦 **Prep:**
• Kingdom must be 70+ days old
• Hoard speedups, Truegold, gems WEEKS in advance
• Pre-queue building/research to finish during KvK (especially Phase 2)
• Batch troop training to maximize during event window
• Coordinate with leadership on attack strategy

events.name: Alliance Championship
events.reminder:
Alliance Championship starts today! 6 alliances, 5 rounds of battle.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• **Formation:** 50% Infantry (tanks), 20% Lancers (tactics), 30% Archers (damage)
• **Lane Roles:** Strongest players on Main lanes, mid-tier on Secondary, low-power on Sacrifice lanes to slow enemies
• Round 1: Spread strong members across all lanes to scout enemy placements
• Rounds 2-5: Study battle reports and counter enemy patterns with surprise lane switches
• Activate pet skills and buffs BEFORE registering — they stay active for the entire event

📦 **Prep:**
• R4/R5 must register alliance during the 2-day registration window
• Only top 20 players by combat power count — ensure your strongest are registered
• Assign lane roles in advance and communicate via alliance chat
• Pre-set troop formations (don't scramble during prep phase)

events.name: Armament Competition
events.reminder:
Armament Competition is active! Enhance and forge gear for points.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Focus on using Mithril for gear enhancements — highest point value
• Enhancement levels: +20 (Lvl 11 Hammers), +40 (Lvl 12), +60 (Lvl 13), +80 (Lvl 14), +100 (Lvl 15)
• Enhance gear that your main combat heroes actually use for double value
• Use Governor Gear Charms for additional points

📦 **Prep:**
• Buy Mithril and Custom Mythic boxes from the Arena store
• Collect Forge Hammers from Bear Hunt rewards
• Save all gear enhancement materials — do NOT enhance gear outside this event
• Do dailies consistently to stockpile 'enhance' materials
• Collect from Conquest every 9 hours

events.name: Desert Trial
events.reminder:
Desert Trial / Champion's Way is active! Hunt beasts for Weapon Scraps to find Elite Rebels.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Clear all 5 milestone chests first (at 1, 3, 5, 7, and 10 Elite Rebel kills)
• After milestones, put stamina into beast hunting for more Weapon Scraps
• Use **Diana** in rallies to reduce stamina costs
• Enable Auto-Join for rallies — don't miss the 50 daily participation rewards
• Weapon Scraps don't expire — save extras for future use

📦 **Prep:**
• Stock up stamina before the event (1,000+ recommended)
• Level up Diana's stamina-reduction skill
• Coordinate rally times with alliance members
• Save Precious Keepsakes exchanges for after clearing milestones

events.name: Fishing
events.reminder:
Fishing Event is active! New attempts refresh every 3 hours.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Use the Ocean Prospector Map on your FIRST attempt — it maxes fishing gear to Lvl 10 temporarily
• Upgrade order: Hook → Line → Sinker (longer line = rarer, higher-point fish)
• Cast close to the left or right edge to avoid hitting fish on the way down — reach maximum depth
• Target 2-star fish over 1-star — learn to tell them apart visually
• Log in consistently every 3 hours to avoid wasting attempts

📦 **Prep:**
• Set alarms every 3 hours during the event
• Save gems for gear upgrades if you haven't maxed fishing equipment
• Don't waste the Ocean Prospector Map on a short cast

events.name: Hall of Heroes
events.reminder:
Hall of Heroes is active! Collect hero shards and unlock powerful Mythic heroes.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Focus on shards for heroes you're actually building — don't spread too thin
• Prioritize Mythic heroes that complement your main march formation
• Check which heroes are closest to their next ascension milestone

📦 **Prep:**
• Save Universal Hero Shards for this event
• Research which Mythic heroes are meta for your generation
• Have Hero XP items ready to immediately level new unlocks

events.name: Champagne Fair
events.reminder:
Champagne Fair is active! Trade excess hero shards and skill books for Fair Vouchers.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Trade duplicate Rare/Epic shards you don't need — keep Mythic shards
• Use Fair Vouchers to buy: Widgets, Forgehammers, Governor Gear materials
• Prioritize items you can't easily farm elsewhere
• Check the shop daily — stock refreshes and some items are limited

📦 **Prep:**
• Identify which hero shards are safe to trade (heroes you won't build)
• Save duplicate skill books for trading
• Make a wishlist of items you want from the Fair shop

events.name: Golden Glaives
events.reminder:
Golden Glaives is active! Complete Intel Missions to collect Dim Goldstones.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Regular Intel Missions (beast hunting, rescuing refugees) = 1 Dim Goldstone each
• Hunting Golden Glaives on the map = 10 Dim Goldstones each — always prioritize these!
• Trade Goldstones for collection rewards on the event page
• This runs during Strongest Governor prep phase — stack your activities

📦 **Prep:**
• Save Intel Missions if possible
• Keep stamina available for Golden Glaive hunting on the map
• Check the rewards page to see what Goldstone thresholds give the best loot

events.name: Strongest Governor
events.reminder:
Strongest Governor starts today! The most prestigious 7-day competition.

📋 **Official Daily Schedule:**
• Day 1: City Construction (Truegold, speedups, Governor Gear Charms)
• Day 2: Hero Development (Mithril, Hero Shards, Forgehammers)
• Day 3: Basic Skills Up (Skill books, research scrolls)
• Day 4: Combat Training (Highest-tier troops)
• Day 5: Basic Skills Up (Skill books, research scrolls)
• Day 6: Combat Training (Highest-tier troops)
• Day 7: Hero Development (Mithril, Hero Shards, Forgehammers)
⏰ Daily reset at 00:00 UTC

🎯 **Strategy:**
• Day 1: Save Truegold for construction (2,000 pts each). Pre-queue upgrades to finish on reset
• Day 2 & 7: Use Mythic Hero Shards for ascension (3,040 pts each) — these are your biggest point opportunities
• Day 3 & 5: Spend skill books and research scrolls — reliable steady points
• Day 4 & 6: Train T8+ troops in bulk — batch them to maximize efficiency
• Cross-Kingdom Rankings (top 2,000) give the best rewards — track your position and pace yourself

📦 **Prep:**
• Start hoarding speedups, Truegold, Mithril, and Hero Shards WEEKS or MONTHS in advance
• Pre-queue building upgrades (Day 1) and research (Days 3, 5)
• Save ALL Mythic hero shards for Days 2, 3, 5, 7 — don't spend during off-event times
• Batch troop training for Days 4 & 6 with precise timing
• Check leaderboard regularly — don't burn resources early if you can't maintain rank
• Plan your strategy by ROI: Bear Hunt > Strongest Governor > Alliance Brawl > KvK

events.name: Merchant Empire
events.reminder:
Merchant Empire starts today! 7-day caravan trading event.

🎯 **Caravan Strategy:**
• Launch caravans 4–6 hours AFTER daily reset to avoid peak raiders
• Strong troops → Long routes (max rewards). Weaker → Short routes (safer)
• Each caravan takes ~3.5 hrs — plan sends around your playtime
• Use 'Assisting Squads' button once/day to get alliance protection (earn assist rewards up to 3/day)

💀 **Raid Strategy:**
• Max 4 successful raids/day (failed raids don't count against limit)
• Target yellow SSR caravans — best loot even if already raided once
• Raid rival Alliance Brawl caravans to hurt their score
• Crossed swords icon = they raided you first — revenge time!
• 🔥 = raided once, 🔥🔥 = raided twice

📦 **Prep:**
• Coordinate raid targets with alliance — share rival cart locations
• Plan escort schedules so caravans aren't sent when you're offline
• Rotate raid attempts among alliance members to deny rival points

events.name: All Out (Kill Event)
events.reminder:
ALL OUT (Kill Event) starts today!

⚠️ **SHIELD UP if you're not participating!**

🎯 **Strategy (Attackers):**
• Target players with lower Town Center level for easier wins
• Hit milestone benchmarks first for free gems, then decide if you continue
• After hitting milestones, pop a 24-hour Peace Shield immediately
• Tile-hit according to server diplomatic rules
• Coordinate rallies with alliance for big targets

🛡️ **Strategy (Defenders/Non-Participants):**
• Activate Peace Shield BEFORE the event starts
• Send troops to a tile or allied garrison if you can't shield
• Shelter excess resources in the warehouse
• Stay shielded for the full 2 days if you have valuable troops

📦 **Prep:**
• Buy Peace Shields in advance (24h or 8h)
• Move city to alliance territory for safety
• Flag targets with R4/R5 leadership before event starts
• Ensure hospital capacity is full — wounded troops add up fast

events.name: Bear Hunt
events.reminder:
Bear Hunt (Pitfall) is available! The bear deals NO return damage — go full offense!

🎯 **Strategy:**
• **Host (Gen 4+):** Amadeus + Petra + Rosa for optimal Gen 4+ performance
• **Host Formation:** 1% Infantry / 10% Cavalry / 89% Archers (max damage)
• **Joiner Formation:** 0% Infantry / 20% Cavalry / 80% Archers
• **Best joiner heroes (S-tier):** Vivian (new!) > Chenko > Amane — each gives 25% lethality bonus
• R4/R5: Check every joiner's heroes and troops before launching — remove wrong bonuses
• Move alliance cities as close to Pitfall as possible for faster rally return times
• Last 5–7 minutes: ALL members launch their own rally for extra returning-troop hits

📦 **Prep:**
• Upgrade Pitfall using Hunting Arrows (from beast hunting) — up to Lvl 5 (+5% ATK/level, 1,900 arrows to max)
• Pre-set optimal offensive march presets for Host and Joiner roles
• Rally leaders: verify your march composition meets Gen 4+ standards
• Collect Forge Hammers from Bear Hunt rewards for Armament Competition
• Focus on lethality as the primary damage stat

events.name: Sanctuary Battle
events.reminder:
Sanctuary Battle today! Hold outposts for 30+ minutes to occupy them.

🎯 **Strategy:**
• **Formation:** 50% Infantry (tanks), 30% Archers (damage), 20% Lancers (tactics)
• Scout enemies first — adjust troop composition to counter theirs
• Teleport key force leaders while marching secondary troops (hybrid approach)
• Mid-week battles often have lower participation — easier victories
• Define in advance: when to commit vs. when to strategically withdraw

📦 **Prep:**
• R4/R5: Vote on battle time slot based on when your strongest members are online
• Analyze which time slots had weakest resistance in previous battles
• Set up clear comms — alliance chat for live tactical adjustments
• Pre-position cities near target sanctuaries for quick reinforcement
